## Summary

- Add or update resource(s) related to harness engineering

## Checklist

- [ ] The resource is directly relevant to harness engineering
- [ ] The link works
- [ ] The resource is not already listed in `content/resources/`
- [ ] The front matter is complete: `title`, `link`, `category`, `resource_kind`, `source`, `added`, `date`
- [ ] The description explains the harness angle clearly
- [ ] The change is placed in the most appropriate category
- [ ] If this replaces an existing entry, that entry is marked `lifecycle: superseded` with `superseded_by: <new slug>`

You don't need to regenerate `README.md` — that happens automatically after merge.

## Notes

Add any context that would help with review.
